name_zh: 乞力马扎罗/环保先驱：山地生态共治与冰川见证
name_en: Kilimanjaro/Conservation Pioneers: Mountain Eco-Co-Governance & Glacier Witness
description_zh: 乞力马扎罗山 (5895m) 非洲最高峰/赤道冰川/联合国教科文组织世界遗产/坦桑尼亚国家象征。核心生态治理：国家公园管理局(TANAPA)/当地查加族/马赛族/国际NGO/科研机构多方共治——冰川监测(1912-2023 90%+ 消失)/水源涵养/人兽冲突/旅游收入分配/气候难民预案。查加族传统灌溉/林农复合/神圣林保护/山神信仰编码生态法则。体现 M188 山地生态共治——以"冰川监测+流域共治+神圣林保护+旅游收益共享"四位一体，在气候变化/人口压力/旅游开发三重压力下守护非洲屋脊生态本底。
description_en: Kilimanjaro (5895m) Africa's highest peak/equatorial glacier/UNESCO World Heritage/Tanzania national symbol. Core eco-governance: TANAPA/local Chagga/Maasai/INGOs/research institutes multi-party co-governance—glacier monitoring (1912-2023 90%+ loss)/watershed conservation/human-wildlife conflict/tourism revenue sharing/climate refugee contingency. Chagga traditional irrigation/agroforestry/sacred groves/mountain deity beliefs encode ecological laws. Exemplifies M188 Mountain Eco-Co-Governance—quaternity of 'glacier monitoring + watershed co-governance + sacred grove protection + tourism revenue sharing' guarding Africa's roof ecological base under triple pressure of climate change/population/tourism development.
reason_zh: 乞力马扎罗非单纯山峰，而是"冰川水塔+生物多样性热点+文化圣地+气候见证者"四位一体生态系统。查加族传统灌溉/神圣林/山神信仰编码生态法则，TANAPA 现代管理与传统知识融合。M188 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(安第斯)、M180 极地气候(极地)、M178 极地韧性(适应)，核心在于"热带冰川见证+流域共治+神圣林编码生态法"的非洲山地生态范式。
reason_en: Kilimanjaro not mere peak but quaternity of 'glacier water tower + biodiversity hotspot + cultural sacred site + climate witness' ecosystem. Chagga traditional irrigation/sacred groves/mountain deity encode ecological laws, TANAPA modern management fuses traditional knowledge. M188 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (Andes), M180 Polar Climate (polar), M178 Polar Resilience (adaptation), core: 'tropical glacier witness + watershed co-governance + sacred groves encoding ecological law' African mountain ecology paradigm.
steps_zh: 冰川监测与气候见证：1912-2023 卫星/实地/冰芯监测，90%+ 冰川消失/2040 可能消失，IPCC 报告关键数据源
流域共治与水安全：庞加尼河/齐河/基库莱蒂瓦河源头，查加灌溉/马赛牧场/城市供水/水电/跨界协商
神圣林与传统生态法：查加族神圣林/禁伐/祭祀/祖先安葬，生物多样性避难所/碳汇/微气候调节
旅游收益共享与社区保护：年 5 万+ 登顶/门票分成/社区项目/反偷猎/人兽冲突补偿/查加向导/马赛文化体验
气候适应与冰川消失后预案：冰川消失后水源/旅游/生态/文化/身份多重危机预案/跨国合作/科研优先
steps_en: Glacier monitoring & climate witness: 1912-2023 satellite/ground/ice core monitoring, 90%+ glacier loss/2040 potential disappearance, IPCC key data source
Watershed co-governance & water security: Pangani/Ruvu/Kikuletwa headwaters, Chagga irrigation/Maasai pasture/urban supply/hydro/cross-sector negotiation
Sacred groves & traditional ecological law: Chagga sacred groves/no-cutting/rituals/ancestral burial, biodiversity refuge/carbon sink/microclimate regulation
Tourism revenue sharing & community conservation: 50k+ annual summit/fee sharing/community projects/anti-poaching/HWC compensation/Chagga guides/Maasai cultural experience
Climate adaptation & post-glacier contingency: post-glacier water/tourism/ecology/culture/identity multi-crisis contingency/transnational cooperation/research priority
expected_zh: 以"冰川监测+流域共治+神圣林保护+旅游收益共享"四位一体，在气候变化不可逆冲击下守护非洲屋脊生态本底，为热带冰川消失前沿提供治理范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'glacier monitoring + watershed co-governance + sacred grove protection + tourism revenue sharing' guards Africa's roof ecological base under irreversible climate shock, providing governance paradigm for tropical glacier disappearance frontline.
case_zh: 1973 国家公园/1987 世界遗产/1912-2023 冰川 90%+ 消失/年 5 万+ 登顶/查加族 200 万/马赛牧场/2023 冰川仅存 1.7 平方公里/IPCC 报告引用/跨国冰川监测网络。
case_en: 1973 National Park/1987 UNESCO/1912-2023 glacier 90%+ loss/50k+ annual summit/Chagga 2M/Maasai pasture/2023 glacier only 1.7 km2/IPCC citations/transnational glacier monitoring network.
